params.legendary_gate_where:
geo_elo_active >= 2175.0
  AND geo_accuracy_pool = 1
  AND research_excluded = 0
  AND bot_type IS NULL

framing: ELO tier used strictly as a conditioning variable on market mispricing, never as a skill measure or selector -- geo_elo is condemned for skill-ranking, MASTER_HANDOVER_2026-08-15 Section 1. Nothing here reopens that.

tier_definitions.ELITE: geo_elo_active >= 1400.0 (no pool-cleanliness requirement, per derive_tier design note)
tier_definitions.POOL_C: geo_accuracy_pool = 1 (POOL_C_GATE_WHERE-populated; broad tier, not a derive_tier() rung)
